thread:
sanjay: Heads-up — Wave C deploy on Thu (staggered handovers). We have two primary windows to cover: morning 09:00-10:00 PST and afternoon 15:00-16:00 PST. Need owners for each slot, a smoke-run owner, and a rollback contact. Also important: there's a small schema migration in CR#4568 that needs an owner. Can folks claim roles?

kevin: I can take the morning slot (09:00-10:00 PST) and run smoke for that wave. @ben can you confirm CR#4562 is green?

maria: I can do the afternoon slot (15:00-16:00 PST). That’s 23:00-00:00 UTC for me. I don’t want to own the DB migration.

anna: I can own the migration (CR#4568) and be rollback contact for the DB part. Migration is a zero-downtime script but needs someone monitoring replicas. Quick command I’ll run for the migration:```sh
./dbctl migrate --file migrations/20260318_add_flags.sql --verify
```

deploy-bot: release-scheduler: Wave C slots checked — morning and afternoon reserved pending owner confirmation. Canary auto-rollouts disabled for migrations.

ben: FYI CR#4562 needs one more review from @kevin, might block the morning slot if not merged by 08:30 PST. I can do final QA once merged.

kevin: On it, will chase the review. If CR isn't merged by 08:30 PST we should consider shifting morning window +1h. @sanjay ok with up to 11:00 PST? :thinking_face:

sanjay: Yes, we can slide the morning window up to 11:00 PST at the latest. Preference is to keep the afternoon window untouched so the migration doesn't overlap both. Quick smoke checklist to follow in case useful:
```
- services up (auth, api, router)
- perf smoke (top 50 p50 p95)
- health endpoints green /_status
- canary sample queries: chat + embeddings
- regression check set (5 prompts)
```

maria: :thumbsup: I’ll trigger the afternoon smoke and post the results here. I’ll also capture token/latency deltas.

anna: I’ll shadow the smoke run and be ready to rollback DB if anything looks off. Rollback plan (DB):```sh
dbctl rollback --to 20260317 --safe-checks
```
If we need app rollback, we revert the canary tag to `wave-c-prev` and boot the old jobsets.

ben: Noted. I’ll merge CR#4562 by 07:50 PST to keep the morning on schedule. If anything slips I’ll update this thread immediately.

kevin: Thanks — I’ll ping @eng-oncall 30m before the morning deploy to have eyes on infra.

sanjay: Perfect. Final ownership: morning=kevin (smoke), afternoon=maria (smoke), migration/DB=anna (rollback contact), merge owner=ben. I’ll post a one-line checklist 1h before each slot. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
